segments.teaches: this video covers Mudra Bank, set up in 2015 to give financial support to micro and small enterprises; first we must understand what these enterprises are

segments.teaches: an enterprise is any organisation or venture engaged in commercial or industrial activity to earn profit; by turnover and investment in plant and machinery, enterprises are of four types: micro, small, medium, large

segments.teaches: in 2015 the government launched PMMY (Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana); its beneficiaries are non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises (not registered as companies, not in farming), e.g. repair shops, food-service providers, artisans, small traders

segments.teaches: Mudra Bank (Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency Bank) was set up under PMMY in 2015; commercial, cooperative and small finance banks, RRBs, NBFCs and MFIs first register with it and become partner financial institutions

elements.what: PMMY chip at top left
entrepreneurs card kept at bottom right

'Registered' arrow from the Mudra box to the bank box
'PARTNER FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS' over the bank box

segments.notes: 6 change events in 42 s. Arrow direction runs Mudra → banks while the voice says the banks register with Mudra.
segments.idea: Mudra does not lend directly; banks and other lenders register with it as partners
segments.shown_as: the canvas clears to a PMMY chip and the entrepreneurs card at bottom right; the Mudra logo appears in a pink box and its full form writes under it; a pink bank box with a list of six lender types appears at right, a 'Registered' arrow draws between them and the bank box is titled 'partner financial institutions'

segments.teaches: partner lenders give three loans: Shishu up to 50,000, Kishor 50,000 to 5 lakh, Tarun 5 to 10 lakh; the interest is base rate plus 0-7%, set by the bank by credit risk (high risk up to +7%, low risk at base rate), so it is low and flexible; Mudra's own role is refinance
